_comment: THE cross-language names of agent-repl's OWN MCP tools: the tools the
shim's in-process MCP server offers every session, which agent-repl draws
itself rather than as generic MCP tool cards.
The shim (TypeScript) serves the tools and converts their calls off the
stream; the sidecar (Go) converts the same calls off the transcript files.
Two languages cannot compile one constant, so each holds its own and each
asserts it against this file: a renamed tool fails both suites instead of
leaving one plane converting a name the other no longer emits.
`qualified` is the vendor's name for the tool, `mcp__<server>__<tool>`.
